source.description: Recorded reference with explicit engineering error budgets. Spectral bands from 4 kHz upward are diagnostics because the reference filter and sample-rate-dependent processing affect them. Other known mismatches are failures, without polarity inversion or per-case fitting. Limits and path calibration are documented beside the measurements.
